'''2012 European Championship Michael Willis DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Willis]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
